svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
the letters are cut through the copper; from behind each carved line runs right to left
read from behind, line by line: 22 to 18, 23 to 17, 24 to 16, 25 to 15, 64 to 38, 74 to 90
two other mirror orders: the lines taken bottom to top, and the whole text backwards; each with the key on the new order or on the old
lines bottom to top, read then table
lines bottom to top, table then read
whole text backwards, read then table
whole text backwards, table then read
OUT: NO READING; THE MIRROR READINGS FIT NO SHORT KEY
